key_facts: 1-week history of right facial swelling and cellulitis
mass in right maxillary molar area noticed 6 months earlier
extensive, well-demarcated, dense amorphous irregular calcified lesion in right maxilla

shortlist.label: Complex odontoma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the clinical presentation of a calcified mass in the jaw with a chronic time course

shortlist.label: Calcifying epithelial odontogenic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Consistent with the radiographic findings of a well-demarcated, dense amorphous irregular calcified lesion

shortlist.label: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Compatible with the clinical and radiographic features of a calcified jaw lesion

shortlist.label: Cemento-ossifying fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Fits the description of a well-demarcated, calcified lesion in the jaw with a chronic time course

shortlist.label: Fibro-osseous lesion
shortlist.why_kept: Plausible given the radiographic findings of a calcified lesion in the jaw with an extensive and well-demarcated appearance

raw.rationale: The presence of a calcified mass, missing teeth, and a well-demarcated dense calcified lesion in the maxilla are consistent with a complex odontoma, which is a type of benign tumor that can cause tooth displacement and impaction.

rejected.label: Calcifying epithelial odontogenic tumor
rejected.why: This tumor typically presents with a radiolucent lesion with calcifications, not a dense calcified lesion

rejected.label: Adenomatoid odontogenic tumor
rejected.why: This tumor is often associated with an unerupted tooth and has a characteristic radiographic appearance of a well-defined radiolucency, not a dense calcified lesion

rejected.label: Cemento-ossifying fibroma
rejected.why: This tumor typically presents with a well-defined radiolucency with internal calcifications, not a dense amorphous calcified lesion

rejected.label: Fibro-osseous lesion
rejected.why: This term is a broad category that includes several types of lesions, but the specific findings in this case are more consistent with a complex odontoma
